name: Guillotine Blade
text:
Frequency once per day

---
The echoes of the splinter of finality's original purpose resonate through the artifact. For the next minute, your Spectral Dagger gains the benefits of a Vorpal rune. When you use Snicker-Snack with your spectral dagger, the DC of the DC resolve(max(37,@actor.system.attributes.classOrSpellDC.value)) Fortitude save save is 37, your class DC, or your spell DC, whichever is higher.
